summary: The retained SDD928 provider/catalog roadmap and spec132 plan incorporate the accepted October21 deterministic orchestration decision as design and current-source correspondence. Reuse SDD ProviderCatalog declarations, PreparedConfiguration and accepted WorkspaceLifecycle/WorkspaceModel change semantics with Coordination OrdinaryAssignment.WorkspaceExecutionContract and surrounding Requirements, ExecutionProfile capability observations and independently supplied AuthoritativeObligations completeness. Exact repository/component revisions and source closure remain distinct from declared tool/capability/evidence/skill obligations and actual supplier observations. Framework, generated-product, multi-language/component and local work share the accepted lifecycle; domain representation does not extend a restricted production consumer projection. Missing, stale, conflicting or unsupported joins remain explicit gaps/refusals. Existing sdd_provider_catalog retains source ownership; Programme/root must still select the authoritative producer/completeness, freshness joins, Governance evidence meanings and Templates/Wizard consumer revisions before implementation or serialization. No new aggregate, decoder, API, dependency, runtime or compatibility path is introduced. Accepted SDD2.5.3/PR1142 and qualification remain accepted; Governance423(b), contained actual-consumer acceptance and whole928 obligations stay open. This capture records source design incorporation only, not publication, installed qualification or dispatch. Coordination owns correction of its older Atlas309046c citation; protected69a582f is the verified shared contract source.
